lamps.lamp: Parking Brake and Brake System Indicator
lamps.steady: Comes on if there is a problem with the brake system. Stop in a safe place and contact a dealer for repair.
lamps.flashing: Blinks when there is a problem with the electric parking brake system. Avoid using the parking brake and have your vehicle checked by a dealer immediately.

lamps.lamp: Parking Brake and Brake System Indicator
lamps.steady: Comes on if there is a problem with a braking-related system. Avoid high speeds and sudden braking, and take the vehicle to a dealer immediately.
Comes on when the automatic brake hold system is on.
Comes on when the automatic brake hold is activated.
Comes on if there is a problem with the emissions control systems. Avoid high speeds and get inspected at a dealer.
lamps.flashing: Blinks when a misfire in the engine's cylinders is detected. Park in a safe place and wait for the engine to cool.

lamps.steady: Comes on when there is a problem with the charging system. Stop in a safe place and contact a dealer immediately.

lamps.flashing: Blinks if the transmission system has a problem. Avoid sudden starts and acceleration and have your vehicle checked by a dealer immediately.

lamps.steady: Indicates the current shift position.
Comes on when the paddle selector is pulled, or comes on with M when the shift lever is in M and pulling the paddle.
lamps.flashing: Blinks when deceleration does not occur while pulling the paddle selector.

lamps.steady: Comes on if there is a problem with the electric vehicle system. Have your vehicle checked by a dealer.
Comes on when the vehicle is ready to drive.
Comes on when the vehicle is moved by the motor, and the engine is not operating.
Comes on if you or passengers are not wearing a seat belt when power mode is ON.
lamps.flashing: Blinks while driving if seat belts are unfastened. Beeper sounds.

lamps.steady: Comes on when the fuel reserve is running low. Refuel your vehicle as soon as possible.
lamps.flashing: Blinks if there is a problem with the fuel gauge. Have your vehicle checked by a dealer.

lamps.steady: Comes on if there is a problem with the ABS. Vehicle still has normal braking ability but no anti-lock function.
Comes on if there is a problem with the EPS system. Have your vehicle checked by a dealer.

lamps.lamp: Turn Signal and Hazard Warning Indicators
lamps.flashing: Blinks when you operate the turn signal lever or press the hazard warning button, or during hard braking.

lamps.steady: Comes on when the high beam headlights are on.
Comes on when the position, tail, and other external lights are on.
Comes on when the fog lights are on.
Comes on when all the operating conditions of the auto high-beam are met.

lamps.flashing: Blinks if the immobilizer system cannot recognise the key information or if the system is malfunctioning.
Blinks when the security system alarm has been set.

lamps.steady: Comes on when the ECON mode is on.
Comes on when you press the CRUISE button.
Comes on if you have set a speed for cruise control.

lamps.lamp: Low Tyre Pressure/Deflation Warning System Indicator
lamps.steady: Comes on when one or more tyres' pressures are significantly low, the system is not initialised, or after inflation if initialisation is needed.
lamps.flashing: Blinks for about one minute and stays on if there is a system problem, compact spare is installed, or after 12-volt battery disconnection until driven.
